title: Zombie 4: Darkness - 20-second preparation music
summary: A 20-second preparation (freeze-time) cue played before each Zombie 4: Darkness round in most regions.
description: The Zombie 4: Darkness page notes that the 20-second preparation music does not play in the Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies and Vietnam versions, confirming that a dedicated pre-round track exists in the other regions (South Korea, Taiwan/Hong Kong, China, Japan, Singapore/Malaysia, Indonesia). The official track title was not captured; the wiki also mentions that the mode's voice announcer changed per region.
_confidence: medium (existence and length stated; title unknown)
